name: salmon-science-research
description: Thin skills front door for salmon ecology, conservation, and management science: routing, entity normalization, ontology term lookup through metasalmonpy, Salmon Data Package workflows through metasalmon or metasalmonpy, and narrow adapters for public salmon data platforms.
